fields.name: Birthday & Anniversary
fields.summary: Engage with loyal customers on their birthday or a specific anniversary with a special reward.
fields.longDescription:
Celebrating a customer’s birthday or anniversary is a simple and effective way to recognize each customer individually and personalize their experience.

A birthday or anniversary reward is the perfect yearly opportunity to re-engage inactive customers and continue to reward loyal ones.

### Example:

An online retailer wants to show their appreciation to loyal customers by offering a discount during their birthday month.

The company launches a Birthday & Anniversary Program to send a $25 credit to users one week before their birthday.

### Features:

* Choose how many days before their birthday or anniversary to give a reward.
* Choose whether to reward based on date or month.
* Set as a one-time reward or give a gift every year.
* Target specific customer segments.
* Customize the email to notify users when their reward is ready to use.
fields.installGuide:
# Birthday & Anniversary Program Setup Guide

## Setup

The Birthday & Anniversary program evaluates users eligible to earn rewards with a custom field. By default this custom field is **`birthday`**. This field **must** be an [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) date without the year for customers to  successfully  evaluated. Follow the `--MM-DD` format.

Ex. June 10, 1980 = `--06-10`

Please refer to [our documentation](https://docs.referralsaasquatch.com/features/custom-user-fields/) for more information about custom fields and SaaSquatch.

### Rules

Once your users are set up to be evaluated by the program, you can choose your program rules. This section contains an outline of the available rules for the Birthday & Anniversary program.

![Program Setup Screen](//images.ctfassets.net/1th1ybv0b2n4/GQgM51rDeucRYNPSgZ8hk/dcfc2062261e4187cb9061c07dd04b20/Screen_Shot_2019-07-15_at_12.33.30_pm.png)

#### *Reward Users this many days before their Birthday or Anniversary*

This rule lets you determine if customers should be rewarded either on the actual date, or at the beginning of their birth/anniversary month. If you choose to reward customers on their date, you also have the option to set how many days before you want to issue the reward. 

__This value must be no less than 0 and no greater than 365.__

#### *Begin Rewarding Mode*

If you select the ‘Anniversary Month’ option, you have a choice of when existing customers are rewarded after the program launches. Options include: 

* Immediately after the program launches

* On the first day of the next month

If set to "Immediately after the program is activated", all customers with a date in the current month are rewarded when the program launches. For subsequent months, customers with a date in the current month receive rewards on the first day of that month.

If set to "On the first day of the next month," customers with a date in the current month aren't rewarded. The reward cycle begins on the first day of the month after the program launches.

#### *One-time or recurring rewards*

Use this rule to determine whether customers are rewarded every year on their date, or just one time (ie. their next birthday only).

## Launching

When you have set up your program and are sending the configured `customFields`,  you can use our automated program validation feature to ensure that everything is setup and running. We still **strongly** recommend manually testing the program to ensure everything is working as intended.

After your program is thoroughly tested, you’re ready to go! Activate your program by pressing the `Launch` button in the portal and start evaluating customers to be rewarded.
